pairs.a: Members can use the gym 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
pairs.b: The gym is closed to members every night between midnight and 5 a.m.
pairs.rationale: The rules compared no values: A states durations (24 hours, 7 days); B's only number is the clock time 5 a.m., parsed as a bare count. A vacuous 'the values agree' is not positive evidence of compatibility, so the pair must reach the AI.

pairs.a: Since the 2024 rule change, the sports club's juniors train on Tuesdays.
pairs.b: Junior training at the sports club has been on Thursdays since the 2024 change, with Tuesdays kept for seniors.
pairs.rationale: Both sides state the same time ("since the 2024 change"). A time scope shared by both sides is not a difference in context.

pairs.a: The farm co-op sells its milk solely to Greenvale Dairies.
pairs.b: Part of the co-op's milk goes to a local cheesemaker.
pairs.rationale: "a local cheesemaker" is not the local environment. "Solely" makes A exclusive, so B's other buyer contradicts it.

pairs.a: Clients must sign the engagement letter before the law firm opens a file.
pairs.b: Signing the engagement letter is optional; the firm can open a file without it.
pairs.rationale: "before the firm opens a file" is a precondition, not a past time. Required vs optional under the same policy cannot both hold.

pairs.a: All pull requests to the main branch need approval from at least two maintainers.
pairs.b: Documentation-only pull requests to main can be merged with one approval.
pairs.rationale: Not a guard case (never scoped). The recorded AI read "documentation-only" as a separate context, though "All" covers it. Fixed in the prompt; only a new model answer can show the effect.

pairs.a: The cinema's adult ticket currently costs £11.
pairs.b: As of this month, an adult ticket at the cinema is £9.50.
pairs.rationale: Not a guard case. "Currently" and "as of this month" both mean now. Fixed in the prompt; only a new model answer can show the effect.

pairs.a: The dental practice's new-patient fee was raised to £60 in January.
pairs.b: New patients at the dental practice pay £45.
pairs.rationale: The guard's intended case: "was raised … in January" sets A in a stated time that B lacks. It must stay held at possible.

pairs.a: The music festival allows refillable water bottles on site.
pairs.b: The festival also provides free water refill stations near each stage.
pairs.rationale: "near each stage" is not the staging environment. Recorded AI: compatible, so un-scoping it costs no precision on replay.
